name: HBR AttackUp icon
transformation: Original texture with a programmatic corner arrow composited over it (Pillow polygon, 8x supersampled, orange-red up arrow with a dark outline, bottom-right corner). No resizing, recoloring of the original pixels outside the arrow, crop or AI generation. Reason: the original shares this base art between the buff and the debuff and draws the up/down label separately; the mod marks the up power with this up arrow and, since 2026-11-08, the attack/defense down powers with the matching down arrow.

usage.note: The original has one 64x64 Texture2D; both icon roles reuse it.

limits: Original icon asset identity and provenance only. No Godot importer, package or game run was performed.
